data.name: Ayn
data.gender_notes: Ayn is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Ayn (عين), which means 'the one'. In Islamic context, Ayn is a spiritual name that symbolizes being unique and chosen by God. The name Ayn carries the meaning “The One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayn usually hope their child will grow to embody the one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of uniqueness and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Ayn belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayn total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عين
in_arabic.meaning: العين في اللغة العربية تعني العين أو النظر
in_arabic.long_meaning: العين اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم، ويعني العين أو النظر، وهو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الإبصار والرؤية، وفي اللغة العربية، العين هي الحاسة التي تمكن الإنسان من الرؤية، ومن هنا جاءت الأهمية الكبيرة لهذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: عین
in_urdu.meaning: عین کا مطلب ہے آنکھ یا نظر
in_urdu.long_meaning: عین ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے آنکھ یا نظر، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ تعالیٰ کے ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، اور قرآن کریم میں اس کا ذکر آیا ہے، عین کی اصطلاح عربی زبان میں آنکھ کی حس سے متعلق ہے، جو انسان کو دیکھنے کی صلاحیت دیتی ہے

in_hindi.name: अयन
in_hindi.meaning: अयन का अर्थ है आंख या दृष्टि
in_hindi.long_meaning: अयन एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है आंख या दृष्टि, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह अल्लाह के नामों में से एक है, और कुरआन में इसका उल्लेख आया है, अयन की शब्दावली अरबी भाषा में आंख की इंद्रिय से संबंधित है, जो मानव को देखने की क्षमता देती है

In various Islamic folklore and literature, the name "Ayn" has been associated with beautiful and wise characters, such as the fairy Ayn Al-Qasrawiya from Egyptian folklore or the brave and wise character "Ayn Al-Qudsi" from various Islamic legends.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Ayn" holds a significant meaning for Muslims. The name is derived from the root 'Ayn, which is used in various Islamic verses to describe God's uniqueness and oneness. Muslims believe that each individual is unique and chosen by God, just as the letter 'Ayn is unique in the Arabic alphabet and holds great significance. The name reflects an individual's spiritual connection to the divine and reminds them of their unique purpose and destiny in life.
